newsitem.title: UK: Ugland says good start to shipping strategY.
newsitem.headline: Ugland says good start to shipping strategY.

text.p: Ugland International Plc said today it had made a good start with its restructured shipping business as it reported results for 1996.

Ugland reported pre-tax profits of 3 million stg for the year to December 31, 1996 compared with 1.2 million stg for nine months to the end of 1995. The company changed its accounting reference date during 1995.
Chairman Andreas Ugland said: "This was a good start for the restructured business which confirms our strategy of concentrating on two core activities."
Ugland said it concentrated its activities on seaborne vehicle transportation and the refrigerated cargo carrier (reefer) markets in November 1996.

"The first three months of 1997 have seen a sustained strong performance from vehicle transportation and trading in line with expectations for the reefer business. I am confident about the outlook for 1997," it added.

"The group is committed to the continued development of its vehicle transport interests organically and by acquisition. Further investments will also be considered in the reefer market provided attractive rates of return, supported by medium term charters, can be achieved on new acquisitions," Ugland said. -- Paul Berrill Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087
